name: ThreadCam
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
ThreadCam puts your design on real 3D garments right in the chat. Ask ChatGPT for a logo, a slogan or a picture, or share your own artwork, and ThreadCam shows it on a t-shirt, hoodie, sweatshirt, cap, shorts or sweatpants that you can spin and look at from every side.

Drag and resize the design, move it from a small left-chest logo to a full front or back print, and try it in the garment's real colours. Ask for changes in plain words ("make it smaller", "try it in sand", "put it on the back") and the panel updates in place.

When you like it, ThreadCam tells you what it costs to print and ship, and gives you a secure checkout link on threadcam.com. Your garment is printed on demand and shipped to you. Orders ship to more than 200 countries, up to 50 items per order, in mixed sizes.

If you already have a ThreadCam account, you can connect it to use the features your account includes inside the panel.

Limitations: ThreadCam won't print trademarked logos, characters or other people's artwork. The 3D mockup is a preview, so colours and print position on the finished garment can differ slightly.
